# Hephaestus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Hephaestus associated with?", "Greek, God of forge"),
    ("What is notable about Hephaestus?", "Hammer"),

    ("What is key fact?", "Hammer"),

        print("Correct.")
